item.title: Navigator Midstream expands into natural gas infrastructure
item.description: Navigator has announced the expansion of its existing midstream platform with a dedicated natural gas infrastructure focus.

item.title: RDP closes financing documents for Buenaventura project
item.description: Following the closing of Regasificadora Del Pacifico S.A.S.’ financing documents on the Buenaventura project, EXMAR will be leasing and operating an FSU to the company for a period of five years.

item.title: GTT receives order for LNG carrier tank design
item.description: GTT has received an order from the Jiangnan shipyard for the tank design of four new LNG carriers on behalf of Shandong Marine Energy.

item.title: Naftogaz signs grant agreement with EBRD for imported gas
item.description: Naftogaz has signed a grant agreement with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development for €85 million which will be directed toward financing the purchase of imported natural gas.

item.title: Volvo Trucks reaches LNG-powered milestone
item.description: Volvo Trucks has delivered more than 10 000 LNG-powered trucks globally since it was introduced in 2018.

item.title: StocExpo announces first wave of speakers for 2026 conference programme
item.description: StocExpo has announced the first confirmed speakers for its 2026 conference programme, taking place at Rotterdam Ahoy on 10 – 11 March 2026.

item.title: INOX India powers Indian Railways’ LNG fuel trial for DEMU trains
item.description: INOXCVA has provided 2200 l LNG storage and regasification systems for integration into 1400 high-pressure dual power unit cars of dual-fuel diesel electric multiple unit trains to Indian Railways.

item.title: ABB launches integrated carbon capture measurement solution
item.description: ABB has announced the launch of its first fully integrated gas analyser package for carbon capture, utilisation, and storage applications for the decarbonisation of hard-to-abate industries.

item.title: Babcock LGE receives 150th order for LNG reliquefaction system
item.description: Babcock’s LGE business has secured its 150th contract for its ecoSMRT® LNG reliquefaction system.

item.title: Worley tapped as technical advisor for New Zealand LNG import terminal
item.description: Worley will provide technical advisory and client engineering support for the development of New Zealand’s LNG import terminal.
